crossRefs.note: Have mercy on me, God, according to your loving kindness. According to the multitude of your tender mercies, blot out…
Wash me thoroughly from my iniquity. Cleanse me from my sin.
Hear my prayer, Yahweh. Listen to my petitions. In your faithfulness and righteousness, relieve me.
Hurry to answer me, Yahweh. My spirit fails. Don’t hide your face from me, so that I don’t become like those who go…
Yahweh is my strength and my shield. My heart has trusted in him, and I am helped. Therefore my heart greatly rejoices.…
Behold, God is my helper. The Lord is the one who sustains my soul.

translations.web: Hear, Yahweh, and have mercy on me. Yahweh, be my helper.”
translations.bsb: Hear me, O LORD, and have mercy; O LORD, be my helper.”
translations.kjv: Hear, O LORD, and have mercy upon me: LORD, be thou my helper.
translations.asv: Hear, O Jehovah, and have mercy upon me: Jehovah, be thou my helper.
